name: OpenAirInterface 5G RAN (OAI)
description: Full 4G LTE and 5G NR Radio Access Network implementation. Includes gNB, eNB, and UE (nrUE) with RF simulator mode for containerized testing.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Official Docker images on Docker Hub (oaisoftwarealliance/oai-gnb, oaisoftwarealliance/oai-nr-ue). docker-compose at ci-scripts/yaml_files/5g_rfsimulator/docker-compose.yaml for RF simulator deployment.

eval_notes: Most comprehensive open-source RAN: full PHY/MAC/RLC/PDCP/RRC/SDAP stack. RF simulator enables fully containerized E2E testing. Includes PHY layer simulators (DLSIM, ULSIM, LDPC, etc.). O-RAN E2 interface support. Highest data rates among open-source options.
